name: research-figure-pipeline
description: Editable research figures with independent transparent illustrations and native Visio elements. Derived from Fu Jincheng's original workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Transparent illustrations and native editable Visio elements.
interface.longDescription: Fork maintained by shich2001, based on Fu Jincheng's Research Figure Pipeline. Preserves approved-master review and visible local Visio assembly, adds independent transparent illustrations, native editable cards/text/arrows, a reusable renderer and structural validation.
defaultPrompt: Create an approved research master, then an editable native Visio figure.
Separate illustrations from editable cards, labels and arrows.
Check both visual quality and Visio object editability.
